title: Spice Palette Combination Generator
description: A gourmet chef wants to experiment with every possible combination of spices available in the kitchen. Given a list of distinct spice names, write a function to generate all possible subsets of these spices.
constraints: The number of spices in the input list is between 1 and 10.
All spice names in the input list are unique.
The output can be returned in any order.
input_format: A list of strings representing distinct spices.
output_format: A list of lists containing all possible subsets of the spices.

examples.explanation: All possible combinations of salt and pepper include the empty set, individual spices, and both together.
For a single spice, the subsets are just the empty set and the single-element set.
An empty list of spices yields only the empty subset.
